name: 28546 · Jacksonville, NC
findings: ZIP 28546 (Jacksonville) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28546 (Jacksonville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28546 (Jacksonville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
